newsitem.title: UK: EU work rules could reverse UK jobless trend-Major.
newsitem.headline: EU work rules could reverse UK jobless trend-Major.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Tuesday that the European Union working hours directive could reverse the falling trend in British unemployment.

"Unemployment is falling here as we become more competitive," Major told parliament at question time. "This directive could reverse that trend, and similar directives could push unemployment up instead of it continuing to fall."
"I am not prepared to accept that. I want jobs, not directives," he added.

The European Court earlier ruled that the directive must apply to Britain. But Major said he would refuse to agree changes to the EU's Maastricht Treaty being discussed at the Intergovernmental Conference unless his European partners agreed to reverse this ruling.
"Without treaty change there will be no conclusion to the Intergovernmental Conference," he told MPs. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
